articles.title: Cop31 host urges wealthy countries to spend ‘much more’ on climate than defence
articles.highlight: 土耳其部长表示，“气候问题就是安全问题”，富裕国家在气候危机上的支出应远超北约成员国承诺的GDP 5%国防开支。
articles.summary: 在斐济举行的太平洋 Pre-Cop 峰会上，下届联合国气候峰会主办国土耳其的气候部长表示，富裕国家在应对气候危机上的支出应远高于北约成员国承诺的 GDP 5% 国防开支，理由是“气候问题就是安全问题”。但 Cop31 候任主席 Murat Kurum 在各国下月在土耳其开会时是否应重申“摆脱化石燃料”的既有协议上态度含糊。这则新闻值得关注，因为它显示气候峰会的议程可能更强调安全叙事，同时化石燃料转型承诺面临不确定性。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键点：气候议题正被重新包装为安全议题，这可能改变富裕国家的气候支出理由与谈判重心，但主办方对化石燃料转型的模糊态度意味着核心承诺未必会强化。
articles.sourceExcerpt: ‘The climate issue is the security issue,’ says Turkish minister at Pacific pre-Cop summit in Fiji Wealthy countries should spend far more on dealing with the climate crisis than the 5% of GDP promised by Nato members for defence because “the climate issue is the security issue”, the host of the next UN summit has said. But, in comments that are likely to prove contentious, the Cop31 president-designate, Murat Kurum, hedged on whether countries should try to repeat a previous agreement to “transition away from fossil fuels” – the primary cause of the climate crisis – when they meet in Turkey next month.

en.highlight: “The climate issue is the security issue,” says Turkish minister, arguing wealthy countries should spend far more on climate than Nato’s 5% GDP defence pledge.
en.summary: At a Pacific pre-Cop summit in Fiji, the host of the next UN climate summit said wealthy countries should spend far more on the climate crisis than the 5% of GDP Nato members have promised for defence, because “the climate issue is the security issue”. But Cop31 president-designate Murat Kurum hedged on whether countries should repeat a previous agreement to “transition away from fossil fuels” when they meet in Turkey next month. It is worth reading because it shows how security framing may shape climate negotiations while leaving a key fossil-fuel commitment uncertain.
en.failureAnalysis: Takeaway: framing climate as security may justify larger spending, but the host’s hedging on fossil-fuel transition suggests the core commitment may not be strengthened.
en.title: Cop31 host urges wealthy countries to spend more on climate than defence

articles.title: Setting Personal Boundaries at Work: Trade, Don't Refuse
articles.highlight: 在工作中设定个人边界，很少意味着说‘不’；改掉一个默认做法，用取舍回应请求，并知道它无法解决什么。
articles.summary: 职场个人边界不靠频繁说‘不’来建立：先改变一个长期默认，再把请求变成有取舍的交换，同时承认边界有无法解决的局限。对需要与同事、上级协作的人来说，这提供了一种比硬性拒绝更可执行的沟通思路。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键不是学会拒绝，而是把默认设置和请求回应改成可协商的交换，并清楚边界并不能修复所有问题。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Setting personal boundaries at work rarely means saying no. Change one standing default, answer requests with a tradeoff, and know what it can't fix.

articles.highlight: 语音脑机接口旨在将与言语、语言或交流意图相关的神经活动转化为外部输出，以恢复沟通能力。
articles.summary: 该论文关注语音脑机接口，其目标是把与言语、语言或交流意图有关的神经活动转成外部输出。作者机构包括 Tether Evo、莫纳什大学 Turner 脑与心理健康研究所及罗马第二大学。该方向对恢复沟通能力的研究具有基础性意义。
articles.failureAnalysis: 所给原文仅为标题、作者机构和摘要开头，未包含方法、数据集或实验结果，无法据此评估语音脑机接口的实际性能与泛化能力。因此，当前只能确认研究主题与机构背景，不能得出技术有效性或临床可用性的结论。
articles.sourceExcerpt: From Neurons to Conversation: Speech Brain-Computer Interfaces Moein Khajehnejad1,2,a, Forough Habibollahi1,a, Tommaso Boccato1, Margarida Sousa1, Michal Olak1, Francesco Jamal Sheiban1, Matteo Ferrante1,3 1Tether Evo, 2Turner Institute for Brain and Mental Health, Monash University 3The University of Rome Tor Vergata, Speech brain–computer interfaces (BCIs) aim to restore communication by transforming neural activity related to speech, language, or communicative intent into external outputs such as text, synthesized voice, or avatar control. Recent advances in intracortical and electrocorticographic recording, deep sequence models, and language-model-assisted decoding have enabled rapid progress, including high-performance attempted-speech decoding and increasingly naturalistic speech syn- thesis. Yet these achievements also reveal that speech BCIs are not simply neural-to-text decoders.

articles.title: tigerless-labs/agent-memory
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 这是一个名为 agent-memory 的开源项目，定位为 AI 智能体的长期记忆运行时，核心设计是用纯 Markdown 文件当唯一真相来源，配合本地排序检索，并有一个独立的睡眠期管理（Manage）层在空闲时整理记忆。它让 Claude Code 和 Codex 共用一个记忆库，且不需要配置 API Key。对非技术管理者来说，它值得关注是因为它直击智能体「记不住事」这个真实痛点，并把记忆的所有权交回用户本地文件。
articles.failureAnalysis: 记忆的真实需求存在，但「纯 Markdown 当唯一真相来源」在记忆量变大后容易遇到检索效率与一致性问题，本地排序检索的效果通常弱于依赖云端嵌入模型的方案，直接影响可用性。项目不依赖 API Key 意味着分发门槛低，但也说明它很难自然形成付费闭环，商业化路径不明。最大的风险来自平台方：Claude Code、Codex 等工具自带记忆功能一旦成熟，这类第三方中间层的生存空间会被迅速挤压。此外 3392 星只证明开发者关注度，并不等于有稳定的生产级使用与留存。

en.highlight: Long-term memory runtime for AI agents: plain Markdown as the source of truth, local ranked retrieval, and an independent sleep-time Manage layer.
en.summary: This is an open-source project called agent-memory, positioned as a long-term memory runtime for AI agents, using plain Markdown files as the single source of truth, local ranked retrieval, and a separate sleep-time Manage layer that consolidates memories when idle. It lets Claude Code and Codex share one memory store with no API key required. It is worth reading because it targets a real pain point, agents forgetting things, while keeping memory ownership in local user files.
en.failureAnalysis: Using plain Markdown as the source of truth may strain retrieval efficiency and consistency as memory grows, and local ranked retrieval is typically weaker than cloud embedding-based approaches, which caps real usability. Its biggest risk is platform risk: if Claude Code and Codex ship mature native memory, third-party layers like this lose their space, and 3392 stars signal developer attention rather than durable production usage.
